name: Cross-Cohort Knowledge-Tracing Benchmark
description: This replication package accompanies the manuscript “Do Knowledge-Tracing Model Rankings Generalize Across Student Cohorts? A Comparative Study of Accuracy, Calibration, and Stability in Mathematics Learning.” It contains the complete analysis pipeline, exact software requirements, aggregate model-performance metrics, student-clustered bootstrap results, de-identified common-target prediction probabilities, and publication-ready figures for a comparative benchmark using the corrected ASSISTments 2009–2010 and official ASSISTments 2015 Skill Builder datasets. The benchmark evaluates a global baseline, Bayesian Knowledge Tracing, Performance Factors Analysis, Deep Knowledge Tracing, and Self-Attentive Knowledge Tracing under identical learner-level partitioning and evaluation procedures. Raw ASSISTments data are not redistributed; official source URLs and SHA-256 hashes are provided in the README.
